assets.purpose: Cards diagram: Techniques for balanced participation (wide layout).

assets.purpose: Compare diagram: Reframing a pilot request (wide layout).
assets.license: Original diagram authored for this course; no third-party elements
assets.alt: A comparison of a broad pilot request with a focused reframe. A broad request asks to see what Glean can do, for everyone, open-ended. The reframe defines the question, a cohort, the priority workflows, success criteria, and a decision date.
